# "Content Generated by AI" 章节：**草稿**（待你确认后定稿）

> 状态：**草稿**。按你的裁定「由我出草稿供你确认」（INDEX §213 第五条），**我不自行定稿**。
> 使用方法：把 §1 的英文段落替换/填入论文的 `## Content Generated by AI` 章节；
> §2 列出**你必须确认的两处**；§3 说明我没有写什么（以及为什么）。

## 1. 英文正文（建议替换）

```text
## Content Generated by AI

An AI coding assistant (DeepSeek, model deepseek-v4-flash) was used during this work for the
following, and only the following: (i) writing and iterating the analysis, post-processing and
figure-generation scripts, and the COMSOL Java batch probes, all of which are stored in the project
repository with recorded hashes; (ii) maintaining the append-only decision-and-correction ledger that
records every ruling, revision and self-corrected error; (iii) generating the LaTeX/markdown revision
history of this manuscript by scripted, anchored text replacement; and (iv) drafting and copy-editing
English prose. Every numerical result reported here was produced by COMSOL Multiphysics or by the
project's own analysis scripts, not by the assistant. All scientific judgements - acceptance
thresholds, the choice of figure of merit, the decision to report negative results as results, and
every ruling recorded in the ledger - were made by the human author(s). The assistant did not select
which results to report, did not assign confidence to any claim, and did not sign off on any gate.
```

## 3. 我**没有**写什么（以及为什么）

- **没有写"AI 未参与科学判断"就了事** —— 事实上 AI 参与了很多**分析与自查**（例如发现并订正了 6 处我自己的错误、
  提出互斥假设并逐一排除）。但**判断与签字始终在人**，所以我把措辞钉在"**人做判断、AI 做工具与自查**"这条线上，
  而不是笼统否认参与；
- **没有写"结果经过 AI 验证"** —— 那会误导：真正的验证是**可复现性与留痕**（每个数字都能追到产物），
  不是"另一个模型看过"；
- **没有替你把"人"写成"作者"** —— 用的是 `the human author(s)`，具体称谓由你定；
- **没有写具体仓库路径或主机名** —— 双盲要求（补充材料与正文均已单独扫描过）。
